candidates.comment: Thanks for the request. Windows 11 primary context-menu integration was enabled for stable builds in https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/commit/3e56b3a2a4002a63b82bdcfdb7ea5873dbc6957e, so “Open with Code” can appear directly on folders without Shift+right-click. This completes the requested capability; installation cases where the entry still does not appear are tracked separately, including https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/304214. The fix shipped in 1.109.0.
